text: ここは　ぜんこくの　かくとうか　が　あつまる　どうじょう　だ！

structure.jp: ぜんこくの　かくとうか　が　あつまる
structure.en: where martial artists from all over the country gather

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぜんこくの　かくとうか　が　あつまる　どうじょう
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits right before a noun and tells you which kind of thing it is. ぜんこくの　かくとうか　が　あつまる　どうじょう = 'a dojo where martial artists from all over the country gather'.
